title: A sheaf with vanishing stalks is zero
statement:
Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of modules on a scheme $X$. If
$\mathcal F_x=0$ for all $x\in X$, then $\mathcal F=0$.

proof.text: Use the existing upstream theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isZero_of_isZero_stalk in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Cohomology.FiniteFibre, as identified by upstream review #1428. The duplicate local theorem is retired; there are no local declaration callers to adapt.
